nodes.text: Made Me Stop Friday 🛑 Show me the photo that made you stop. The one that made you pull the car over, stop mid-walk, or just stare for a second too long. This rainbow over red trees did that to me. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A vibrant rainbow cuts through a dramatic gray, cloudy sky, positioned just above a tree with striking red and green autumn leaves.

A vibrant, turquoise blue alpine lake sits cradled within dry, rolling golden hills under a dramatic sky filled with scattered white cumulus clouds. Distant mountains stretch across the horizon, completing the serene wilderness landscape.
A vibrant rainbow arches across a dramatic, dark gray storm sky above a neighborhood of traditional brick homes with orange-tiled roofs and lush green trees.

A wide-angle, low-angle shot captures a vibrant rainbow arcing over a vast, windswept moorland under a dramatic sky of dark, rolling clouds and patches of blue. The barren landscape is bathed in a warm, golden light, with patches of dry grass and low-lying vegetation stretching towards the horizon.

A vibrant golden sunset beams through the tall pine trees, casting a warm glow over a serene lake. The tranquil water reflects the fading light while a paved path covered in fallen pine needles leads the eye toward the water's edge.

A vibrant pink and orange sunset paints the sky with wispy, feather-like clouds above a suburban neighborhood. Silhouetted trees and the roof of a house frame the lower edges of the colorful evening scene.
A young couple stands close together in a dimly lit museum, admiring art displays on a purple wall. In the background, another visitor in a long dress walks away, adding depth to the scene.

replies.text: Museum date. Were they looking at the art or each other?

photos: A massive blue glacier flows down between dark mountain peaks, ending at the water's edge. Icebergs float in the gray water in the foreground, suggesting a cold, remote wilderness environment.
A vibrant rainbow arcs across a dramatic, cloudy sky, casting a colorful glow over a calm body of water with a distant city skyline along the horizon.

nodes.text: Water Wednesday favorites 🏆 Four waters that stopped my scroll. @peanutbutterscotch_ @keithreid__photography @eye.mac @paulsparks85 - beautiful work, all of you.
photos: A high-angle view captures McWay Falls in Big Sur, California, flowing from a rugged cliff onto a secluded sandy beach next to the crashing turquoise waves of the Pacific Ocean. In the foreground, a dense patch of delicate pinkish-white morning glory flowers frames the picturesque coastal landscape under a moody, overcast sky.
A long-exposure shot shows a gentle waterfall cascading over dark, mossy rocks, framed by lush foliage and scattered autumn leaves.

A wide-angle, medium shot captures a portion of Niagara Falls on an overcast day, with a heavy, misty cloud hanging over the rushing water. The horseshoe-shaped falls feature a pale green water color, and heavy white foam rises from the churning water below, contrasting against the dark, dramatic clouds overhead.

A dead tree and several jagged stumps rise from a calm, shallow body of water that mirrors them under a pale blue evening sky. The horizon is flat and distant, creating a serene and minimalist landscape.

replies.text: What time of day did you catch the water this still? @paulsparks85
That was a new moon, high tide sunset. Extra high tides happen in the Bristol Channel at the time of the new moon. The tidal change is amongst the highest in the world.
Epic! Thanks for sharing the story! And thanks for playing the game 😎
Which side were you shooting from, American or Canadian? @eye.mac
How long was the exposure on this one? @keithreid__photography
Was this your first time at McWay Falls, or a return trip? @peanutbutterscotch_

nodes.text: Animal Thursday 🦆 Show me your best animal shot. Pets being pets, ducks with opinions, squirrels mid-heist, anything with fur, feathers, or scales. This duck stopped me mid-walk and posed like it owned the pond. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A male mallard duck stands on a curved stone ledge beside a reflective pond in a park, with fallen autumn leaves scattered on the ground.
A close-up portrait of a bison in a field of tall dry grass, with a second bison visible in the softly blurred background.
A close-up vertical shot captures a Jungle Carpet Python resting its head on a mossy branch in its enclosure, with foliage and wood visible in the blurred background.

A close-up vertical medium shot captures a small, chubby owl with brown feathers mottled with black and white standing on a perch covered in artificial green grass. The owl, which looks a bit like a tawny owl, stares intently down and to the left of the frame. The background is a mix of colors and textures, including dark wood, brick-like tiles, and artificial green plants. The room is dimly lit, with a blue and purple light cast on the scene.
A brindle whippet is draped over the back of a brown leather sofa in a sunlit living room, its head resting on the top cushion while its back legs dangle down to the floor.
A little pied cormorant dries its wings on a rocky outcrop overlooking green water, its white chest and black back contrasting against the landscape.
An extreme close-up shot captures the profile of a gorilla's face in soft light, highlighting the intricate texture of its skin, fur, and expressive, thoughtful eye.
A majestic male lion with a dark, thick mane rests on the ground amidst dry brush, looking back over his shoulder with piercing yellow eyes.

A close-up captures a white cow with black patches and long, curved horns, looking up and tilting its head as if it's about to moo. It stands among trees in a grassy enclosure, with a brick building and lush green foliage in the background.
A seagull perches on a moss-covered rock in the foreground of a wide, overcast beach, while two distant figures wade in the surf.

A common moorhen forages on the ground, surrounded by sparse grass and scattered dry leaves. The bird’s distinct red beak and shield stand out against its dark feathers, while its bright yellow-green legs are clearly visible as it navigates the terrain.

A close-up shot captures a majestic white swan standing gracefully on a lush green lawn, its long neck arched slightly as it gazes directly at the camera. The bright sunlight filters through the trees, casting gentle dappled shadows on its pristine feathers and the surrounding grass, highlighting the swan's impressive size and bright orange beak.
A small gray squirrel sits in the grass, nibbling on seeds scattered on the ground. Its bushy tail, tipped with white, is curled up behind its back.
A small turtle suns itself on a partially submerged rock in a clear pond, with a gentle waterfall cascading down a rocky ledge in the background.
A large wild turkey with iridescent black feathers and a fanned tail struts proudly across a grassy lawn. In the background, the sunlit porch of a historic house stands next to a large tree trunk.

replies.text: A curious little squirrel I met on an autumn walk. 🐿️🍂 One of those unexpected moments that makes photography so special! 🤎
photos: A red squirrel stands upright amid a thick blanket of fallen yellow and orange leaves in a wooded park. Sunlight filters through the trees in the background, highlighting the vibrant autumn foliage.

A full-body shot of a deer standing on a hillside, viewed from behind in a misty forest. The deer is positioned on a layer of reddish-brown leaves, surrounded by greenery and large, grey rocks. In the background, a wooden structure is visible among the foggy trees.
Several sea lions lounge on grey rock formations under an overcast sky. Two sea lions on the right face each other, while another looks back over its shoulder.
A slightly ruffled seagull walks away from the camera, leaving faint tracks in the sand. Its feathers are tousled by the wind, casting a long shadow on the damp beach.
A single white swan gracefully glides across the tranquil blue water of a lake, framed by lush green reeds and leafy branches in the foreground.
A close-up selfie shows a white-faced capuchin monkey looking directly into the camera with its arms outstretched toward the chain-link fence.
Three turtles sunbathe on a fallen log floating in a tranquil pond, their reflections clearly visible in the rippling water below.
A white cat with black spots sits perched on a stone wall next to a couple of small cacti. In the background, an off-white stone building features a window and tangled vines.
A mother cheetah stands watchfully in tall grass while her playful cubs engage her; one cub stands on its hind legs looking up affectionately, and another nuzzles near her back leg.

A curious black cow with a white patch on its forehead rests in tall grass behind a barbed wire fence. In the background, rolling green hills and autumn-colored trees under an overcast sky create a peaceful rural landscape.
A light-colored mare and her foal stand inside a rustic barn with stone walls, surrounded by straw and hay bales. Both horses wear simple halters, and the mare holds a wisp of hay in her mouth.

A light gray foal with dark legs and a dark mane stands outdoors near a wooden gate and a stone wall. The young horse appears to be stretching its neck forward, perhaps toward an object on top of the wall.

A little girl in a white shirt, purple skirt, and red rainboots stands at a rustic wooden gate, reaching out to pet one of four donkeys lined up behind it. The donkeys, a mix of brown and grey, curiously watch the child from a muddy enclosure surrounded by lush green foliage.

A close-up vertical shot features a seagull perched on a rock by the water. A sassy white goose with an orange beak struts purposefully down a sunlit concrete sidewalk, its mouth open as if it's mid-honk. A long, dark shadow stretches out behind it, highlighting its determined walk in a comical, meme-worthy way.

nodes.text: Water Wednesday 🌊 Niagara, because sometimes water just shows off. Show me your best water shot - puddles, lakes, rain on glass, the ocean doing its thing. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows a massive, rushing waterfall pouring off a rocky cliff into the water below, creating a thick mist that obscures the bottom-right side of the scene. The top of the cliff is dotted with greenery, and the sky is filled with light clouds.

Two people strike dynamic, balletic poses on separate mossy outcrops, silhouetted against the powerful rush of a massive waterfall. The dramatic scale and lush greenery create an inspiring nature escape.

A moody coastal scene features a dark blue and white fishing boat docked near rocky shorelines beneath a dramatic, overcast sky heavy with grey clouds, with a faint rainbow visible in the distance over the sea.
A wide, horizontal photo shows the massive horseshoe-shaped Niagara Falls under a cloudy sky. A heavy mist rises from the turbulent, emerald-green water, partially obscuring the base of the falls.

A tall, multi-tiered waterfall cascades down a rocky cliff face, surrounded by lush green foliage and moss-covered stones. The long-exposure shot gives the rushing water a smooth, ethereal, and misty appearance.

replies.text: Many thanks 😊 taken with an iPhone 📱
Doesn’t matter what you use when you know what you are doing 👍

photos: A high-angle view captures Niagara Falls, featuring both the American Falls and the massive Horseshoe Falls. A vibrant rainbow arcs across the mist below, with a city skyline visible in the distance across the Canadian border.
A wide, rushing river cascades over mossy rocks, its churning white water framed by tall, wild grass in the foreground.

A landscape shot captures the Niagara Falls illuminated with a red light, viewed through bare tree branches at dusk. The sunset paints the sky in shades of orange above the horizon, while a line of distant lights twinkles along the opposite shore.

A high-angle, eye-level shot captures a vibrant patch of wild pink and white morning glories framing a breathtaking coastal view in Big Sur, California. In the background, McWay Falls cascades onto a sandy beach, where turquoise waves crash against dramatic dark rock formations under an overcast sky.

A narrow, gray wooden bridge spans a vibrant blue river, framed by two tall, dark trees in the foreground. The sun casts intricate shadows across the reddish-brown earth at the water's edge, under a clear blue sky.

A long-exposure photograph captures a serene waterfall cascading over dark, mossy rocks, framed by lush foliage. Vibrant red and orange autumn leaves are scattered across the surrounding wet stones, adding a pop of color to the moody, earthy scene.

A bright red sun sets over the ocean, casting a fiery reflection across the water and wet sand of a tranquil beach. In the foreground, a lone bird stands near the shoreline as gentle waves lap the shore, creating a peaceful evening scene.

A multi-tiered waterfall cascades gracefully over dark rocks, framed by lush green ferns, leafy plants, and dense woodland foliage. In the background near the top, a small arched stone bridge spans the stream above a secondary cascade, adding a touch of hidden charm to the enchanted, secluded forest scene.
A full shot features two people riding horses side by side on a beach. Silhouetted against the bright, glinting ocean, the riders move calmly, creating a serene and timeless atmosphere.

A wide, low-angle shot captures a weathered red brick railway viaduct stretching across a calm river, creating a clear mirror reflection of its arches on the water's surface. The overcast sky contrasts with the green hillside in the background, making it a peaceful scene for a nature walk or heritage photography.

A massive wave crashes into the seafront promenade, its explosive spray rising above a dark metal railing that separates the paved walkway from the churning sea. In the background, under a gray, overcast sky, a grassy hill slopes upward to reveal the rugged ruins of an ancient stone castle.

An aerial, eye-level shot captures a large wave crashing against a seawall on a coastal road. The wave explodes upward, its foamy crest soaring high into the air, reaching nearly the height of a hill in the background. The wall runs along the edge of the road, protecting a series of cars parked on the side. Behind the seawall, the turbulent, foamy gray sea churns with white crests. The road curves gently along the coast, with a sidewalk running parallel to the seawall, bordered by a fence. In the background, green hills slope upward from the coast, dotted with trees and a few buildings near the top. The sky is overcast, casting a soft, gray light over the scene.

A still, glassy lake reflects a moody, cloud-filled sky under an overcast day. Framing the water, steep green mountains slope down to the shoreline, with several smooth rocks scattered just beneath the surface in the foreground.

nodes.text: Pattern Tuesday favorites 🏆 Five patterns that stopped my scroll. @mapletreephotography_wpm @medium.gords7 @blue.cheese.ranch @michaelgiancarlo772 @yvetime - beautiful work, all of you.
photos: A ground-level, wide-angle shot captures a train station at night, with a train stopped on the left and the textured metal platform stretching into the distance. Bright lights line the ceiling overhead, casting a cinematic glow over the empty platform.

A straight walkway extends between a red brick wall on the left and a row of dark wooden support pillars on the right, all beneath a covered overhang lit by a line of hanging lamps. The ground is paved with light grey stone bricks, catching a stark line of sunlight that contrasts with the deep shadows.

A close-up shot captures a complex arrangement of interlocking metal gears bathed in a warm, reddish light. The industrial machinery creates an intricate pattern of intersecting circles and jagged teeth, emphasizing a mechanical aesthetic.

A high-angle shot captures the colorful patterned fabric of a tent ceiling converging into a central focal point at the bottom, creating a vibrant, textured canopy of rich reds, blues, yellows, and whites.

A close-up shot captures a dense cluster of vibrant golden-orange and green compound leaves, creating a stunning gradient of autumn color. The intricate, feathery foliage fills the entire frame, perfect for a nature-inspired aesthetic.

replies.text: That diamond-plate floor in the foreground - planned low angle or happy accident? @michaelgiancarlo772
That corridor pulls you straight in - did you wait for the light or just get lucky? @mapletreephotography_wpm
Those gears look like they've been working for a century - where did you find them? @blue.cheese.ranch
We have a food truck park decorated with local artists sculptures. This was so interesting from so many angles
Thanks for sharing the story. I like the shot a lot! Strong one ☝️
That fabric is doing the most - what is it actually covering? @medium.gords7
Golden-orange against the green - is that peak autumn where you are? @yvetime
it’s Sorbaria sorbifolia ‘Sem’. Its leaves emerge bronze-red in spring, mature to deep green with burgundy tips in summer, and turn brilliant orange-red in fall. 🍂

nodes.label: water, sky, shot, green
nodes.snippet: Photographers, Pattern Tuesday 📸📸📸 This playground floor is…
nodes.text: Photographers, Pattern Tuesday 📸📸📸 This playground floor is just a grid of little holes and I can't stop looking at it. Find me a pattern - repeating, hypnotic, accidental, whatever. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A macro shot of a blue, perforated playground platform covered in morning dew, with blurred red and blue playground equipment in the background.

An overhead, high-angle view of a pond covered in a dense carpet of green and yellow lily pads, their circular shapes tightly overlapping and creating a textured, nature-inspired abstract pattern across the water's surface. A few unopened flower buds peek through the foliage, adding a subtle touch of depth to the tranquil scene.
A chain-link fence casts a striking geometric shadow across the green surface of a tennis court, creating a playful interplay of light and texture.

A close-up shot of a vibrant coleus plant, featuring striking leaves with lime green centers, deep purple edges, and bright magenta veins. In the background, fuzzy, magenta plumed cockscomb flowers add a whimsical contrast, all captured in a garden setting.

A close-up, top-down view captures a massive pile of fresh purple and white garlic bulbs, their tangled roots facing outward. The vibrant colors and rustic textures create a striking, aromatic display, perfect for a culinary or farmer's market post.

A vertical, eye-level shot captures the tall, illuminated Hotel Sevilla Center at dusk, its bright white signage glowing against the dark blue sky. The building features alternating dark grey and off-white panels, with glowing square windows scattered across the facade. In the foreground, a tall, decorative metal fence runs along a paved walkway, partially obscuring a grassy area with sparse white flowers and some lush green trees.

A black-and-white, low-angle shot captures a metal screen with round perforations casting a pattern of bright circular lights onto a concrete walkway below, which is separated by a narrow drainage grate.
A low-angle, close-up shot captures the curving backs of rows of stadium seats receding into the distance, rendered in shades of grey.

A medium eye-level outdoor shot displays industrial ceramic electrical insulators, which are brown, stacked disc-like shapes, with some white horizontal disks. The insulators are attached to metal hardware in front of a brick building. The sky is grey and overcast, and trees frame the scene.

A close-up, black-and-white abstract shot of a metal cheese grater, emphasizing the repetitive pattern of its raised, jagged holes. The low-angle perspective and textured background create a dramatic, almost futuristic landscape.

A close-up eye-level view shows a tree trunk with pronounced, spiraling bark ridges and textured green leaves in the upper half. The background, bright from sunlight, reveals a parking lot with several red cars and a white building in a park setting.

An eye-level shot captures a large chandelier of glowing glass globes hanging from a dark ceiling, casting a warm yellow light. The strands recede into the distance, appearing smaller and tighter together, creating a hypnotic, repeating pattern.

replies.text: A chandelier of glowing globes receding into the dark. Hypnotic is the word.

photos: A scenic view of rippled wet sand on a beach leading to the calm sea, where the sun sets on the horizon beneath a sky filled with dark, dramatic clouds. Golden sunlight reflects off the water's surface and glistens on the ridges of the sand, creating a serene and captivating atmosphere.

replies.text: Rippled sand catching the sun's reflection path. Nature doing corduroy in gold.
Frank Lloyd Wright designed Marin Civic Center building.
photos: A low-angle view captures the Marin County Civic Center in San Rafael, California, with its iconic blue roof and repetitive arch motifs on a clear, sunny day. The long, horizontal structure extends into the distance, framed by lush green foliage in the foreground.

replies.text: Wright doing arches on repeat. That rhythm goes on forever.

photos: A mesmerizing installation of numerous iconic turquoise Tiffany & Co. gift boxes suspended in mid-air creates a captivating, floating cloud effect. The overhead view, enhanced by reflective surfaces, suggests an immersive luxury retail experience designed for social media sharing.

replies.text: Hundreds of teal boxes floating mid-air. Somebody's storage unit achieved enlightenment.

photos: A low-angle view captures the towering height of a massive, rough-barked tree, its thick trunk tapering upward into a canopy of green leaves against a blue sky. Sunlight filters through the branches, highlighting the texture of the bark and creating a sense of being deep within a lush forest.

replies.text: Straight up the trunk. That bark has stories.
Circular holes and rectangular windows sharing one facade. The building couldn't pick a shape.
Soap on my window in the car wash
photos: Horizontal streaks of soapy foam wash across a car windshield during an automated car wash, partially obscuring the view of the machinery outside.

replies.text: Car wash foam doing abstract art on your window. The pattern found you.

photos: A black-and-white, eye-level, medium shot shows grapevines growing through a grid fence in front of a white wall. The vines are bare, creating strong vertical lines, and cast shadows against the white wall.

replies.text: Bare vines threading the grid and throwing shadows on the wall. Are those grapevines, or something else entirely?

photos: A top-down, vertical close-up shot shows a green leaf made up of many smaller green leaflets.  The small leaves are shaped like ovals and are lined with parallel white ridges that look like delicate veins.  The small, green leaves are attached to a large central vein and are also arranged in a pattern with leaves opposite each other on the stem.

replies.text: Bipinnate is a great word and an even better pattern. Those white ridges are doing lacework.

photos: A straight-on, eye-level, medium shot shows a wall made of gray rectangular bricks. The bricks feature a slightly uneven surface texture, giving them a rustic yet modern appearance.

replies.text: Gray bricks with just enough unevenness to keep it interesting. Rustic meets modern, as promised.
I actually like that photo. I like the way it looks and from a different perspective
photos: A close-up shot of a curved wall made of textured, light-colored concrete blocks, with a shallow depth of field drawing focus to the foreground stones.

replies.text: This is at a place in Portland Oregon called Hopscotch. Fun interactive experience .
photos: Dozens of glowing, spherical purple lights of various sizes hang in long, vertical strings against a dark, contrasting background, creating an immersive, ethereal atmosphere.

replies.text: Dozens of glowing purple orbs hanging in strings. Hopscotch sounds like my kind of place.

photos: A close-up shot captures a dense cluster of vibrant golden and orange foliage contrasted against lush green leaves, suggesting the arrival of autumn.

replies.text: That golden-orange cluster going off against the green. Autumn flexing.

photos: A high-contrast black-and-white image showcases the architectural details of Marina City in Chicago. The tightly cropped photo emphasizes the building's distinctive rounded balconies, which create a striking, repetitive geometric pattern of arches and shadows.

replies.text: Marina City's balconies doing their corncob rhythm in black and white. Iconic pattern.

photos: A top-down, slightly angled view of a textured rock shelf covered in countless small barnacles, dark patches of damp algae, and wisps of green seaweed. The muted earthy tones and weathered surface suggest a low-tide scene along a rugged coastline, perfect for a nature-focused or tide-pooling post.

replies.text: Countless barnacles doing their tiny volcano thing. The tide pool has range.

photos: A close-up, black and white photograph highlights the intricate, ribbed texture of a single, large hosta leaf. Other foliage surrounds it in a dense, natural arrangement.

replies.text: One hosta leaf doing full ribbed texture in black and white. Nature's corduroy.

photos: A wide-angle, slightly low-angle, outdoor, eye-level shot captures the Yininmadyemi - Thou didst let fall memorial at Hyde Park in Sydney, Australia, with the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Opera House visible in the background under a clear blue sky. On a grid-like black metal platform, dozens of black metal slouch hats are arranged in neat, receding rows that angle from the lower left to the upper right. The hats, each with a brim and a domed crown, are identical in size and shape, creating a pattern of dark shapes against the textured metal surface. The platform is bordered by a strip of green grass and a paved walkway, where several people are walking along the waterfront. In the background, across the sparkling blue water, the white, sail-like structures of the Sydney Opera House stand out, while to the left, the dark, curved arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge spans the sky. The bright sunlight casts soft shadows from the hats onto the metal platform.

replies.text: Rows of slouch hats in formation with the Opera House behind. That's a pattern with a memorial behind it.
The info board says “individually unique military helmets” but they’re patently identical.

photos: A view of a canal in Venice, Italy, through an ornate black iron window grill. The canal water reflects the light, and a grand palazzo building is visible on the opposite bank.

replies.text: Venice through an iron grill. The grill is the pattern, the canal is the reward.

photos: An overhead, close-up shot captures a dried, brown flower with a spherical center, dusted lightly with white, against a blurred, pale tan background.

replies.text: A dried flower doing its spherical-center thing, dusted white. Quiet pattern.

photos: A high-angle, slightly diagonal shot captures a sprawling Japanese city stretching toward the horizon beneath a clear blue sky. A winding river cuts through the dense urban landscape filled with closely packed houses and buildings, under bright daytime lighting.

replies.text: A whole city laid out like a circuit board with a river running through it. That diagonal framing works.
I'm glad you liked it. Thank you. Seeing Japan from above might offer an interesting perspective. If you were just walking around the city, you'd only see a much more ordinary world.
Fantastic! To be fair though, Japan streets are never ordinary 🤭
That's how it may seem to tourists. But everything changes when you live in Japan.

photos: A straight line of faded green bollards runs along a narrow city sidewalk, casting sharp shadows on the ground on a sunny day. The modern urban architecture in the background features textured yellow and beige buildings with geometric window grates.

replies.text: A line of faded green bollards standing at attention, shadows in formation. The sidewalk has discipline.

photos: A low-angle view captures an ornate vaulted ceiling covered in a grid pattern of pale panels decorated with red and blue circular motifs and small floral borders.

replies.text: That vaulted ceiling is doing grids, circles, and florals all at once. Overachiever.
Water having its way with square tiles.
photos: Water ripples distort a turquoise and lime-green mosaic tile surface, creating a vibrant pattern. Sunlight dances across the iridescent tiles, adding a dreamy, aquatic texture.

replies.text: Water having its way with the tiles is right. That ripple distortion is doing all the art.

photos: A top-down view of a round, metal manhole cover embedded in the pavement, featuring a complex, concentric geometric pattern of raised shapes and some eroded lettering around its outer edge.

replies.text: A manhole cover doing sacred geometry. The eroded lettering is just mysterious enough.
This is the spherical roof of the thermal baths. The colors of the pool lights are beautifully reflected in the glass.
photos: A low-angle view captures the intricate glass and steel framework of a modern dome ceiling, illuminated by blue light and reflecting hints of green and yellow from within.

replies.text: A thermal bath roof doing stained glass with pool lights. Beautiful is right.

photos: A lush, vibrant green forest floor carpeted with ferns and low-lying vegetation is framed by a grove of tall, slender tree trunks under a sun-dappled canopy.

replies.text: Ferns doing the carpet, trunks doing the columns. The forest has interior design.
I hadn't thought of it that way 🤔
We all read the photo differently 🤭 so, tell us, what’s your read?
I saw the grouping of 3-1-3 trees and the way it made a triangle. Columns of a different sort.

photos: A low-angle view captures a modern architectural overhang featuring a dark, perforated surface with numerous organic, rounded cutouts. Through the pattern, patches of a vibrant blue sky and green tree leaves peek through.

replies.text: An overhang full of organic cutouts with sky peeking through. The building is breathing.
It’s this shaded walkway, in Hyères, France
photos: A sunlit urban promenade features a long, curving white trellis structure overhead, casting a complex, patterned shadow across the stone-paved walkway. Buildings and green trees line the sidewalk under a clear blue sky.

replies.text: The wide shot! So the first one was the close-up of this same walkway. Hyères really knows how to do patterned shade.
MKE Public Market, Nikon Zf, Nikkor 40 mm F11 1/250
photos: A high-angle, black-and-white shot captures the bustling interior of a large market, housed beneath an expansive industrial ceiling of exposed steel beams and corrugated metal. Below, parallel display cases and vendor stalls line the ground floor, where shoppers weave through the aisles, all framed by the dramatic, geometric perspective of the overhead structure.

replies.text: Shot on the Zf at f/11 and every beam is sharp. That ceiling is doing the heavy lifting.

photos: A vibrant, richly patterned fabric tent ceiling showcases an explosion of colors and intricate bohemian designs. The accordion-pleated panels radiate outward, creating a mesmerizing optical illusion and a cozy, eclectic atmosphere.

replies.text: An explosion of patterned fabric with pleats radiating everywhere. Hypnotic.

It is on the ceiling of the billiards room in the basement of Graceland mansion in Memphis, Tennessee, USA. If I recall correctly, the walls are covered in the same fabric. ￼￼It was pretty wild to see in person. ￼
Yeah, it must be impressive. Thanks for sharing.
Here’s mine. iPhone 14 Pro Max. Pink Abstract Pattern
photos: A close-up shot of a vibrant, hot pink circular art installation made of woven wooden branches radiating outward. The intricate, textured pattern creates a striking focal point with a pop of vivid color.

replies.text: A hot pink sunburst of woven branches. It radiates.
Love the color and selective focus!! Cool!!📷

photos: An overhead view of light gray cobblestone ground with a grid-like metal drainage cover on the right side.

replies.text: Cobblestones doing their quiet grid thing, and the drainage cover had to join in.

photos: A perspective shot of a long, narrow outdoor corridor bordered by a red brick wall on one side and a row of heavy wooden pillars on the other. The overhead structure features a line of hanging industrial-style pendant lamps that lead the eye down the sunlit, paved walkway toward a distant building entrance.

replies.text: That corridor pulls you in like a film still. The hanging lamps are doing the leading.

photos: A high angle full shot captures wavy ripples in a pool with teal and white tiles at the bottom, creating abstract lines and shapes.

replies.text: Pool ripples over teal tiles making abstract art. The water's showing off.
It wasn't a pool. It was at Wapping, reflected buildings...
Ouch, did I miss read, … again? 😬

photos: A striking black-and-white, low-angle shot captures a metal fire escape zig-zagging up the side of a weathered brick building, illuminated by bright overhead lights on each level.

replies.text: A fire escape zigzagging up the brick in black and white. Most dramatic staircase to nowhere.

photos: A modern, geometric chandelier with woven mesh shades hangs indoors, illuminating a space that offers a scenic ocean view through a nearby window.

replies.text: A chandelier with an ocean view. Some lights have it all.

photos: A close-up shot of a chain-link fence, weathered with rust spots, forms a diagonal pattern against an out-of-focus background. The metallic texture and repetitive diamond shapes create a stark industrial feel.

replies.text: Rusty chain-link doing diamonds on the diagonal. Industrial lace.

photos: A dewy spiderweb gleams in the morning sun, intricately spun between tall blades of grass against a soft, dark background.

replies.text: Morning dew turned that web into jewelry. The spider's an artist.

photos: A low-angle view captures the intricate white structural support beams and suspension cables of the Peace Bridge against a vibrant blue sky in Calgary, Alberta. A high-rise building with a grid-like window pattern stands on the right, providing an urban context to the scene.

replies.text: Those white beams against the blue are doing all the work. Calgary showing off.
It’s actually the Humber Bridge in Toronto
Oh, sorry. Silly me recognize it wrong… again 😬

photos: A low-angle, eye-level, close-up shot focuses on a series of triangular metal handles connected to overhead monkey bars in a playground, captured in grayscale. The handles recede from the center into the background, creating a perspective that looks down the length of the parallel bars.

replies.text: Monkey bars in grayscale look like a tiny brutalist city. Love the perspective.
Thanks. My inspiration was a bit different though.. band album covers. I shot for a few different perspectives, as one might see the members of the band.
Sure! Thanks for sharing, Rob. I actually was a bit surprised seeing yours, I took this this March: 🤭
photos: A row of metal triangle-shaped rings hangs from a playground monkey bar, receding into the distance. The background is softly blurred, revealing hints of a park with lush green trees and what appears to be blooming pink flowers.

replies.text: Kidding aside, this was one of the other shots.
photos: A close-up, black and white shot of playground monkey bars, focusing on the curved metal handholds receding into a soft-focus background of trees and a playground structure.

replies.text: Nice shot, nice details and textures
Oh that’s cool. You know what they say about great minds. Apparently the same could be said for ours, too. 😅

photos: An overhead, high-angle view showcases rows of charming brick brownstones in a dense urban neighborhood, with a light dusting of snow on their dark roofs. Bare trees line a street in the middle ground, separating the residential blocks and adding a touch of winter atmosphere to the scene.

replies.text: Snow-dusted brownstones from above. The roofs do the pattern, the trees just visit.
A mountain of popcorn with zero structural integrity and I respect that.

photos: A collection of heavy, weathered metal gears with distinct spiral teeth interlocks in a complex mechanical arrangement, bathed in a warm, amber-toned light. The close-up perspective emphasizes the industrial texture and intricate design of the machinery, creating a dramatic and textured composition.

replies.text: Gears locked together like they're keeping a secret. That amber light does favors.

photos: A low-angle shot captures the grandeur of the multi-tiered, octagonal pagoda tower, featuring dark brick walls, white railings on each level, and ornate golden dragon statues perched at its corners. The structure stands against a vibrant blue sky filled with scattered, wispy clouds.

replies.text: A pagoda with dragons on every corner. The sky is just the backdrop.

photos: A tall residential building features a striking facade with undulating, wave-like balconies made of copper-toned metal, contrasting against a clear blue sky.

replies.text: Those balconies look like the building is doing the wave. Front row seats for the whole street.
And the view of the lake too.
Bottles of wine on a rack
photos: A mesmerizing close-up shows a large matrix of glowing blue lights arranged in three distinct sections against a black background, creating an abstract, futuristic geometric pattern.

replies.text: That looks very similar to a project we have done before!
photos: A sleek, modern wine cellar is bathed in dramatic blue lighting, with floor-to-ceiling racks of wine bottles lining the walls and a central display stand holding select bottles.

replies.text: Shot mine 20 years ago as well as this. Defo some similarities
photos: A wide shot captures a striking wine cellar with curved walls completely lined with thousands of bottles, creating a hypnotic pattern of lights. A brightly illuminated staircase ascends centrally, drawing the eye upwards between the curved shelves and echoing the cool ambiance of the space.

replies.text: Two blue-lit wine cellars in one thread, and both are good shots. Great minds stock alike.
A whole grid of glowing blue bottles. This is what a wine cellar dreams about.
Reynolds Aluminum building in Southfield, Michigan.
photos: A low-angle, medium shot shows two panels of a building exterior with round, gold, geometric patterns that resemble leaves overlapping one another, and metallic framing against a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Those interlocking rings look like Olympic medals had a baby with a sunshade. Mid-century showing off.
Minors Yamasaki showing off! They are supposed to look the ring bottoms of aluminum cans.

photos: A light green plastic light switch is set against a matching light green textured fabric wall with a woven-in darker green rectangle pattern. The switch, oriented vertically, has an ivory-colored toggle that is down. The light switch plate is held in place by two flat-head screws, one at the top and one at the bottom, matching the switch plate color.

replies.text: The wallpaper had a whole pattern going and the light switch still stole the show.

photos: A daytime view of an outdoor restaurant patio features striped shadows from a pergola stretching across the gray concrete ground and round pillars. Tables with black metal chairs fill the area, while a single person sits in the background near a building with glass doors and a white exterior.

replies.text: The pergola turned the whole patio into a zebra crossing. Shadows doing the heavy lifting.

photos: A grand, light-filled atrium features a grid-patterned floor made of opaque glass squares, topped with a massive, ornate chandelier hanging from a towering, pitched glass ceiling. Arched entryways line the upper and lower levels, with blue circular ottomans scattered across the main floor and small figures dotting the expansive space.

replies.text: That checkered floor is one chess game away from greatness. The skylight grid up top seals it.

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot highlights the repetitive grid pattern of heavy steel girders and rivets beneath an overpass. The dramatic geometry emphasizes the industrial scale and architectural strength of modern infrastructure.

replies.text: Rivets in formation, steel doing geometry. Industrial poetry.

photos: A view of a sunny landscape through the stripped, dark timbers of a ruined building, creating a stark contrast of light and shadow. The foreground is littered with debris and wooden panels, framing the expansive green fields under a bright blue sky.

replies.text: The window frames are holding the view like a gallery wall. Ruin with a frame game.

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot captures the striking, geometric facade of a modern high-rise building with a pattern of square cutouts on its left side and stacked balconies on the right. Puffy, light clouds fill the sky in the background.

replies.text: A building wearing a perforated mask. The little square holes are doing all the talking.

photos: A worm’s-eye-view shot shows the Arndale building, a monolithic, brown, Brutalist high-rise with countless uniform windows, against a dramatic, moody sky of dark, rolling clouds. The lighting is slightly muted, enhancing the imposing, gritty texture of the concrete structure.

replies.text: Hundreds of windows, one brooding sky. Arndale understood the assignment.

photos: This striking, high-contrast, black-and-white abstract image plays with stark shadows and geometric patterns, creating a visually compelling piece that looks like a digital art print.

replies.text: Stare at this long enough and it starts moving. Hypnotic in the best way.
Shot from the floor up - the diamond plate does the pattern, the station does the drama. Love the depth.
Me encantaría colaborar contigo algún día. Tu estilo es increíble. Sería un sueño.
photos: A computer screen displays a doctored BBC News website featuring a prominent photo of YouTuber MrBeast in front of a "Beast Games" logo. Below the image, a misleading headline announces a new challenge offering a cash prize of 2850€ through an external website, "PREDY.NET."

Four friends enjoy swimming in a calm river flowing through a lush valley beneath towering granite cliffs. The sunlit scene highlights the breathtaking natural beauty of Yosemite, perfect for an outdoor adventure post.

A vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of bright orange, pink, and purple, with mackerel clouds overhead. The sun's golden glow reflects off the gentle water, while a dark, rocky jetty extends into the water from the right foreground towards a dark horizon of trees.

replies.text: The sky doing the most and the water just reflecting all of it. Show-offs, both of them.

photos: A low-angle, black-and-white shot showcases a large, dark building facade with an intricate pattern of wavy, organic shapes. The building's design creates a strong textural contrast against the smoother, lighter stone structure on the left.

replies.text: That facade looks like the building is wearing chainmail. Very knightly.

photos: A massive, rust-colored industrial wall made of stacked metal components stretches into the distance, with the name "Vogt" visible on the clamps.

replies.text: Wow!! Amazing image!! Love the pattern and color!!📷
A whole army of rusty bolts standing at attention. The Vogt ones look like they're in charge.
My new Halloween duvet cover (from tk maxx).
photos: A dark fabric features a spooky damask pattern of ornate scrollwork intertwined with subtle motifs of skulls, ravens, and spiderwebs.

replies.text: Skulls, spiders AND bats? That duvet is doing Halloween overtime. TK Maxx coming through.
And crows. And spiders' webs. Love it.

photos: A close-up shot focuses on an off-white, textured mat featuring a repeating zigzag or herringbone pattern, possibly made of rubber or a similar durable material. The shallow depth of field creates a sense of depth, with the pattern softly blurring toward the top and right edges.

replies.text: Herringbone so tight it could be a fingerprint. Zoom in further and you'll find the meaning of life.
